notes: All In One Downloader 7.3: One History button on the main page with Video and Audio tabs, size of every file and the total size, and a search box. While downloading you see how much is done and the full size (for example 12 MB / 45 MB). History now marks files that were deleted, offers Copy link and Download again, and asks before deleting a file. A clear message when the phone storage is full. Updates are now compulsory: the app asks for the update and cannot be used until it is installed.
